# AliExpress

9 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 2 standard (1 credit), 6 advanced (5), 1 custom (flat/metered) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

## GET /v1/aliexpress/categories - 1 credit (standard)

Returns the AliExpress category tree: parent and subcategory ids and names. Use a category_id on search or search/hot.

**Use when** you want to get a category_id before calling search or search/hot.
**Cost** cache 1800 s
**Paging** single page - The category tree is a single dump (563 rows live). There is no page or cursor param.

**Response** `SearchResult` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ category_id, category_name, parent_category_id }` (inferred from a sample): `category_id`, `category_name`, `parent_category_id`.

Page-level: `data.dropped`.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/aliexpress/categories" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/aliexpress/product - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns one AliExpress product: title, sale price, original price, currency, shop name, images, sold count, and category. Pass the numeric product id or the full aliexpress.com/item/{id} URL. Optional country, currency, and language localise the price. A product that does not exist, or is not sold to that country, comes back 404 and is not billed. There is no product description on this surface. For reviews call GET /v1/aliexpress/reviews. For similar items call GET /v1/aliexpress/product/similar.

**Use when** you already have a product id or an aliexpress.com/item URL. For discovery, start at search.
**Cost** cache 600 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `product_id` (optional, string) - AliExpress product id, the numeric id in a product URL: aliexpress.com/item/3256812847028710.html is product id 3256812847028710. Product ids also come back on every row of GET /v1/aliexpress/search and GET /v1/aliexpress/search/hot. · e.g. `3256812847028710`
- `url` (optional, string) - Full AliExpress product URL, for example https://www.aliexpress.com/item/3256812847028710.html. The product id is extracted from the path.
- `country` (optional, string) - Ship-to country as a two-letter code. Default US. Changes displayed price and availability. A product that exists for US can return empty for another country.
- `currency` (optional, string) - ISO 4217 currency for displayed prices. Default USD. Live-validated: USD GBP CAD EUR UAH MXN TRY RUB BRL AUD INR JPY IDR SEK KRW ILS THB CLP VND.
- `language` (optional, string) - Copy language as an ISO code. Default EN. Live-validated: EN RU PT ES FR ID IT TH JA AR VI TR DE HE KO NL PL MX CL IN.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `product_id`, `url`.

**Response** `Product` object at `data`, `{ product }` ([full schema](schemas/Product.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `product.id` | Platform product ID… |
| `product.title` | Product title |
| `product.url` | Direct URL to the product page |
| `product.image_urls` | Primary image URL, or an array of image URLs for products… |
| `product.seller` |  |
| `product.price.currency` |  |

+2 more fields in the full schema.

**Next** `aliexpress/reviews` (`product_id` ← `data.product.id`) - Get AliExpress product reviews. · `aliexpress/product/similar` (`product_id` ← `data.product.id`) - Get similar AliExpress products.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/aliexpress/product" \
  --data-urlencode "product_id=3256812847028710" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/aliexpress/product/shipping - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns shipping fee, origin country, and min/max delivery days for one product SKU and a ship-to country. sku_id comes back on every product row. Optional price is the sale price used for free-shipping thresholds. Default tax_rate is 0.

**Use when** you have a product id and a sku_id from product or search and need the shipping quote.
**Cost** cache 600 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `sku_id` (required) - SKU id for a colour or size variant. Comes back on every product as sku_id. · e.g. `12000060082591973`
- `product_id` (optional, string) - AliExpress product id, the numeric id in a product URL: aliexpress.com/item/3256812847028710.html is product id 3256812847028710. Product ids also come back on every row of GET /v1/aliexpress/search and GET /v1/aliexpress/search/hot. · e.g. `3256812847028710`
- `url` (optional, string) - Full AliExpress product URL, for example https://www.aliexpress.com/item/3256812847028710.html. The product id is extracted from the path.
- `country` (optional, string) - Ship-to country as a two-letter code. Default US. Changes displayed price and availability. A product that exists for US can return empty for another country.
- `currency` (optional, string) - ISO 4217 currency for displayed prices. Default USD. Live-validated: USD GBP CAD EUR UAH MXN TRY RUB BRL AUD INR JPY IDR SEK KRW ILS THB CLP VND.
- `language` (optional, string) - Copy language as an ISO code. Default EN. Live-validated: EN RU PT ES FR ID IT TH JA AR VI TR DE HE KO NL PL MX CL IN.
- `price` (optional, string) - Sale price in the target currency, used for free-shipping calculation.
- `tax_rate` (optional, string) - Tax rate as a decimal, for example 0.1. Default 0.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `product_id`, `url`.

**Response** `Analytics` object at `data` (inferred from a sample): `delivery_days`, `max_delivery_days`, `min_delivery_days`, `ship_from_country`, `shipping_fee`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/aliexpress/product/shipping" \
  --data-urlencode "sku_id=12000060082591973" \
  --data-urlencode "product_id=3256812847028710" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/aliexpress/product/similar - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns products similar to a source product id, or to a keyword if no product id is passed. 10 per page by default. Product id takes precedence over query when both are set.

**Use when** Use it after product or search when you want nearby listings.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** page (native `page`) · 10/page by default, max 50 · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/10) x 5 credits

**Query params**

- `product_id` (optional, string) - AliExpress product id, the numeric id in a product URL: aliexpress.com/item/3256812847028710.html is product id 3256812847028710. Product ids also come back on every row of GET /v1/aliexpress/search and GET /v1/aliexpress/search/hot. · e.g. `3256812847028710`
- `url` (optional, string) - Full AliExpress product URL, for example https://www.aliexpress.com/item/3256812847028710.html. The product id is extracted from the path.
- `query` (optional, string) - Keywords used when no product_id is passed.
- `page` (optional, integer, min 1) - Page number, starting at 1. Prefer the universal cursor parameter.
- `page_size` (optional, integer, 1-50) - Products per page, 1 to 50. Default 10.
- `sort_by` (optional, enum: price_low | price_high | most_sold | least_sold) - Result ordering: price_low, price_high, most_sold, or least_sold.
- `country` (optional, string) - Ship-to country as a two-letter code. Default US. Changes displayed price and availability. A product that exists for US can return empty for another country.
- `currency` (optional, string) - ISO 4217 currency for displayed prices. Default USD. Live-validated: USD GBP CAD EUR UAH MXN TRY RUB BRL AUD INR JPY IDR SEK KRW ILS THB CLP VND.
- `language` (optional, string) - Copy language as an ISO code. Default EN. Live-validated: EN RU PT ES FR ID IT TH JA AR VI TR DE HE KO NL PL MX CL IN.

## GET /v1/aliexpress/reviews - 5-9 credits (request-shaped)

Returns written customer reviews for an AliExpress product, 20 per page, each with text, translated text when present, star rating, reviewer name, country, date, and photo URLs. A product with no reviews comes back empty and is not billed. Optional filter: all, 1-5 (star), image, additional, local. Optional sort_by: default or newest. Pair filter=local with country to keep reviews from that country.

**Use when** you have a product id and need the review text. A product with no reviews comes back empty and is not billed.
**Cost** price moves with `label` · cache 300 s
**Pricing** 5 credits per page. The default labels (sentiment, issue) are free. label=reports, incentivized or injection holds 4 extra credits and refunds down to 1 credit per started 25 reviews that were newly judged (the first 100 reviews of a page are judged): reviews already labelled are free, a page where nothing could be judged refunds the whole extra, and a cached page is free.
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** page (native `page`) · 20/page by default · depth unknown · price per N items not proven

**Query params**

- `product_id` (optional, string) - AliExpress product id, the numeric id in a product URL: aliexpress.com/item/3256812847028710.html is product id 3256812847028710. Product ids also come back on every row of GET /v1/aliexpress/search and GET /v1/aliexpress/search/hot. · e.g. `1005006079931969`
- `url` (optional, string) - Full AliExpress product URL, for example https://www.aliexpress.com/item/3256812847028710.html. The product id is extracted from the path.
- `page` (optional, integer, min 1) - Page number, starting at 1. Prefer the universal cursor parameter.
- `filter` (optional, enum: all | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | image | additional | local) - Keep all reviews, only one star value (1-5), only reviews with photos (image), additional comments, or local reviews for country.
- `sort_by` (optional, enum: default | newest) - Review ordering: default or newest.
- `country` (optional, string) - Reviewer country when filter=local. Default US.
- `language` (optional, string) - Copy language as an ISO code. Default EN. Live-validated: EN RU PT ES FR ID IT TH JA AR VI TR DE HE KO NL PL MX CL IN.
- **Shared controls** `label` (sentiment | issue | reports | incentivized | injection; paid: reports, incentivized, injection) · `label_evidence` · `reports` → [labels](api-overview.md#labels-relevance-and-quality)

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `product_id`, `url`.

**Response** `ReviewList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ computed, review }` ([full schema](schemas/ReviewList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `review.text` | Full review body |
| `review.id` | Review ID (parsed from the review URL when not first-class) |
| `review.published_at` | Review creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string… |
| `computed.labels_evidence` | When 1, every labelled row also carries… (with `label_evidence=1`) |
| `review.helpful_votes` | Helpful-vote count (Amazon; null elsewhere) |
| `computed.labels.incentivized` | incentivized: does the reviewer say they got the product… (with `label=incentivized`) |

+7 more fields in the full schema. Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.estimate`, `data.held_back`, `data.labels`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/aliexpress/reviews" \
  --data-urlencode "product_id=1005006079931969" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/aliexpress/search - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns AliExpress products matching a keyword, 10 per page by default (max 50). Each row has product id, title, sale price, shop name, and image. Pass the returned cursor back until has_more is false. Optional sort_by: price_low, price_high, most_sold, least_sold. Optional min_price and max_price are in the smallest currency unit (cents). A query that matches nothing comes back empty and is not billed.

**Use when** you want to find products by keyword. A query that matches nothing comes back empty and is not billed.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** page (native `page`) · 10/page by default, max 50 · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/10) x 5 credits

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Search keywords, for example xiaomi or wireless earbuds. · e.g. `xiaomi`
- `page` (optional, integer, min 1) - Page number, starting at 1. Prefer the universal cursor parameter.
- `page_size` (optional, integer, 1-50) - Products per page, 1 to 50. Default 10.
- `sort_by` (optional, enum: price_low | price_high | most_sold | least_sold) - Result ordering: price_low, price_high, most_sold, or least_sold.
- `min_price` (optional, string) - Lowest price to include, in the smallest unit of the target currency (cents for USD).
- `max_price` (optional, string) - Highest price to include, in the smallest unit of the target currency (cents for USD).
- `category_id` (optional, string) - AliExpress category id. Category ids come from GET /v1/aliexpress/categories.
- `delivery_days` (optional, integer, 1-30) - Keep products that claim delivery within this many days.
- `country` (optional, string) - Ship-to country as a two-letter code. Default US. Changes displayed price and availability. A product that exists for US can return empty for another country.
- `currency` (optional, string) - ISO 4217 currency for displayed prices. Default USD. Live-validated: USD GBP CAD EUR UAH MXN TRY RUB BRL AUD INR JPY IDR SEK KRW ILS THB CLP VND.
- `language` (optional, string) - Copy language as an ISO code. Default EN. Live-validated: EN RU PT ES FR ID IT TH JA AR VI TR DE HE KO NL PL MX CL IN.

**Response** `ProductList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ product }` ([full schema](schemas/ProductList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `product.id` | Platform product ID… |
| `product.title` | Product title |
| `product.url` | Direct URL to the product page |
| `product.image_urls` | Primary image URL, or an array of image URLs for products… |
| `product.seller` |  |
| `product.price.currency` |  |

+2 more fields in the full schema. Page-level: `data.dropped`.

**Next** `aliexpress/reviews` (`product_id` ← `data.items[].product.id`) - Get AliExpress product reviews. · `aliexpress/product` (`product_id` ← `data.items[].product.id`) - Get an AliExpress product by id or URL. · `aliexpress/product/similar` (`product_id` ← `data.items[].product.id`) - Get similar AliExpress products.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/aliexpress/search" \
```
